description: This file defines the interface CommandConsumerFactory for creating command consumers and response senders in the Eclipse Hono project. It includes methods to create command consumers for devices, with options for gateway acting on behalf, liveness checks, and different address patterns. It also provides methods to obtain command response senders. The interface acts as a factory pattern for managing AMQP 1.0 messaging clients for device commands and responses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a CommandConsumerFactory for an existing connection and gateway mapper.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a command consumer for a device, with options for gateway ID and liveness check interval, returning a Future of MessageConsumer.

methods.name: getCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Returns a Future of a CommandResponseSender for responding to commands in a tenant, establishing the link.

methods.name: getLegacyCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Deprecated method to get a CommandResponseSender using the legacy address pattern.
